prompt: A creature sprite for RimWorld: the yanker, an invented alien corridor predator. Side view: profile of the head resting on the coil, spur ridge visible. Rear view, seen from behind: the plated back, spur ridge and anchoring tail paddle face the viewer at the same wide arch and bulk as the front view, head hidden behind the coil. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, clean dark outline with soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. Fully transparent background: no ground, no water, no shadow, no text, no border.
